summary: First E2E test on Data Hub MVP. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth, progress+XP+idempotency, leaderboard, payments config/503, AI 401/402 gates, newsletter valid/invalid). Frontend: 9/10 Playwright flows passed (home, newsletter, signup+header update, SQL sidebar 9 beginner + 6 locked previews, difficulty selector switches sets, cross-module nav, Stats MCQ correct badge, Roadmap 18 items + localStorage persistence, upgrade modal opens after 5 solved). 1 UX bug found: header XP/streak does not refresh in real-time after submitting a correct answer — only updates after page reload or hard refetch of /auth/me.

ui_bugs.issue: After a correct MCQ (POST /api/progress succeeds with +10 XP), the header XP counter still shows the stale value until the user navigates or reloads. AuthProvider.checkAuth() runs only once on mount and QuestionCard/SQLRunner/PythonRunner never call refresh() after posting progress. This makes gamification feedback feel broken.

integration_issues.issue: QuestionCard.submit() calls api.post('/progress', ...) but discards the response and does not call the AuthProvider.refresh() (aka checkAuth) helper. Same pattern likely in SQLRunner.jsx and PythonRunner.jsx.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/QuestionCard.jsx after `await api.post('/progress', ...)` call `refresh()` from useAuth() so the Header XP/streak/level updates immediately. Apply the same fix in SQLRunner.jsx and PythonRunner.jsx.
(Optional) The /api/progress endpoint already returns the updated user; you can call setUser(response.data.user) directly to avoid the extra /auth/me round trip.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthProvider only fetches /auth/me on initial mount — there is no exposed re-sync after mutating actions. Add refresh() calls in runners or push the updated user object back into the context after each progress POST.
auth.jsx: setUser is exposed via context which is good; consumers should use it after POST /api/progress since that endpoint already returns the fresh user.

server.py streak logic in /api/progress: on the very first attempt of the day (days_diff == 0 and streak == 0) streak is set to 1. Subsequent same-day correct answers keep it at 1 which is correct. But if a user signs up and immediately answers, last_active from signup was already set to now → days_diff==0, streak==0 → gets streak=1. This works. No bug.

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' will be rejected by browsers when using cookies. Since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same-origin via ingress it is not exercised, but this is a latent issue if credentials are used from a different origin.
server.py generate_question uses model name 'claude-sonnet-4-6' — verify this exact model id is supported by the Emergent LLM chat client for Anthropic. (Cannot verify without a premium user.)
Header.jsx does `user.name.split(' ')[0]` — safe here because signup requires a name, but a null/empty name would crash. Consider `user.name?.split(' ')?.[0] ?? 'You'`.
test_credentials: Fresh signup performed each run per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Emails used: qa+datahub-<ts>@example.com (backend), qa+ui-<ts>@example.com (frontend). Password TestPass!234.
seed_data_creation: Test users created via /api/auth/signup during test runs; no explicit teardown (users are isolated by unique timestamped emails).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid — no changes needed. The only remaining item is verifying the frontend fix for header XP/streak live refresh after progress POST (in QuestionCard.jsx / SQLRunner.jsx / PythonRunner.jsx). Fix pattern: `const { refresh } = useAuth();` then `await refresh();` after successful api.post('/progress', …). To re-verify: log in, note current XP in [data-testid="header-xp"], answer a correct Stats MCQ, wait 2s, header-xp should increase by 10 without any navigation/reload. Razorpay flow is intentionally unconfigured — /api/payments/order returns 503, which is expected. The Pyodide (/python) Run button was not exercised in this iteration because the ~10MB CDN load slows the run; recommend a targeted retest specifically for the Python runner. AI generation (Claude) also not run end-to-end because it requires a premium user; only the 401/402 gates were verified.
rca of the issue: Header XP not refreshing: AuthProvider (src/lib/auth.jsx) only calls /api/auth/me once on mount via useEffect(checkAuth). QuestionCard.submit() posts /api/progress which the backend correctly processes (verified via pytest — XP goes 0→10 for a beginner correct MCQ) but the frontend never re-syncs the user object. Mitigation: call the exposed `refresh` (== checkAuth) from useAuth after api.post('/progress', ...) OR use the returned user payload: `const { data } = await api.post('/progress', ...); setUser(data.user);`.
